scope: independent root audit of the exact Bockstein construction, p-integrality, determinant digits, content normalization, booked overlap, actual witnesses, one-layer capacity, dependency pins, and deterministic replay

checks.root_repairs: Promoted canonical status and replay paths, retained the already canonical Item421 and earlier dependency pins, and regenerated byte-identical certificate and root replays.

mathematical_audit.scope_and_integrality: The condition p^2>4m+1 makes the top Cartier power q=p; because 4m+2 is even and p^2 is odd, it also exceeds the second pole order. On a rank-zero row, canonical Item149 gives v_p(R_s)>=0 and v_p(L_s),v_p(E_s)>=1, so W_s=(R_s,L_s/p,E_s/p) mod p is well defined.
mathematical_audit.bockstein: The quotient/remainder factorization is exact over Z_(p): omega_s=F_s^p P_s dx with polynomial deg P_s<=p-2. Its zero-constant primitive T_s has only denominators 1,...,p-1. Differentiation gives omega_s=d(F_s^p T_s)-p F_s^(p-1)F_s'T_s dx. Since F_s vanishes at 0 and 1, the exact-differential endpoint is zero and all three coordinate identities follow.
mathematical_audit.first_error_vector: Writing eta_s=F_s^(p-1)F_s'T_s dx gives W_s=(-pR(eta_s),-L(eta_s),-E(eta_s)) mod p. This retains divided characteristic-zero error data and is not another characteristic-p degree-zero test.
mathematical_audit.determinant_digits: Rank zero makes A_m divisible by p and B_m by p^2. Direct expansion gives kappa=A_m/p mod p=det(W_{R,L}) and xi=8B_m/p^2 mod p=det(W_{L,E}). Thus kappa=0 iff v_p(A_m)>=2, while xi nonzero makes v_p(B_m)=2.
mathematical_audit.content_bridge: For odd p in P_m, G_m removes exactly one p-copy. With b=v_p(K_m) in {0,1}, U=D_sharp A/G and V=D_sharp B/G have valuations b+v_p(A)-1 and b+v_p(B)-1. Therefore v_p(c_m)>=b+1 iff kappa=0; if xi is nonzero the depth is exactly b+1.
mathematical_audit.booked_overlap: When p is also in H_m and q=p, p<2m keeps it out of the removed middle product and b=1. Hence the first unbooked post-Item149 layer is present exactly when kappa vanishes.
mathematical_audit.actual_witness: At (m,p)=(13,11), exact Hermite and Bockstein reconstructions agree on W_0=(7,6,6), W_1=(2,8,3). They give kappa=0 and xi=8, so v_11(c_13)=2 exactly. The rows (2,11) and (9,47) independently explain the no-content and upper-strip cases from Item421.
mathematical_audit.capacity: The whole ordinary rank-zero support has one-layer ceiling C_F/6=0.3895079179997942812.... Removing the j=0 strip of rate 2/6 leaves booked-overlap ceiling (C_F-2)/6=0.0561745846664609479.... Even perfect saturation of the whole layer leaves 0.2013511803309796437... outside Item418. These are squarefree support ceilings, not proved masses or bounds on deeper digits.
